mainEntity.name: How do I find a business accountant near me?

acceptedAnswer.text: Enter your postcode, business type and the accounting support you need in our 60-second questionnaire. We match you with a vetted business accountant whose services fit your situation — not just any firm on a map. The matching is free with no obligation.

mainEntity.name: What's the difference between a business accountant and a regular accountant?

acceptedAnswer.text: A business accountant specialises in company, trust and partnership compliance — BAS and GST, payroll and super, financial statements, and structural tax advice — rather than individual tax returns. Many do both, but matching to a firm with genuine business experience means your numbers are handled correctly and you get proactive advice on structure, cash flow and growth.

mainEntity.name: Can a business accountant help with BAS and payroll?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. A registered BAS Agent can prepare and lodge your BAS, and a registered tax agent can manage payroll, STP2 reporting and super guarantee obligations. Tell us you need BAS, payroll or bookkeeping support in the questionnaire and we will match you with a firm that provides those services.

mainEntity.name: Is business accountant matching really free?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. The matching service is free for businesses. We are engaged by the accounting firms in our network, not by you. You are under no obligation to proceed with any matched firm, and the matched firm gives you a clear quote for any work before you commit.

mainEntity.name: How much does a business accountant cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: A company or trust tax return typically costs $500–$1,500 depending on complexity. Ongoing accounting is usually $400–$1,000 per month. The matched firm gives you a clear quote after reviewing your situation — the matching itself is free.

mainEntity.name: Can a business accountant help with Payday Super and STP2?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. From 1 July 2026, Payday Super requires super contributions alongside each payday. Our matched firms implement Payday Super-compliant payroll and STP2 reporting so you meet every deadline and avoid director penalty notices for late super.

mainEntity.name: How quickly will a matched business accountant contact me?

acceptedAnswer.text: Most matches are completed within 60 seconds of finishing the questionnaire. Your matched firm will typically reach out within 2 hours, or you can call for immediate assistance to discuss your business needs.

mainEntity.name: Can a business accountant help me restructure my company or trust?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. The matched adviser assesses whether moving from sole trader to company, or company to trust, makes sense for your income, risk and growth plans — and executes the restructure using CGT rollovers where available to avoid triggering a taxable event.
